avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer that significantly reduces zanubrutinib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; select alternative herbal supplement if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor that increases zanubrutinib exposure and risk of toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use; do not combine with zanubrutinib

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 modulation may slightly affect zanubrutinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for efficacy changes

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild CYP3A4 inhibitory effects at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Monitor closely if used; maintain consistent dosing patterns

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor significantly increasing zanubrutinib bioavailability and systemic exposure, elevating toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely eliminate grapefruit and juice from diet during treatment

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase zanubrutinib absorption; food effect varies but can impact plasma levels
caution_foods.action: Take zanubrutinib consistently with or without food; do not alternate

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous Vegetables (high intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 induction with excessive consumption
caution_foods.action: Maintain normal dietary intake; avoid extreme supplementation

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of toxicity (diarrhea, infections, bleeding) as CYP3A4 inhibitors increase zanubrutinib exposure. Maintain consistent meal timing and composition to minimize pharmacokinetic variability.
